title: Woe Oracles
summary: A woe oracle announces grief, danger, or judgment against a person, nation, or pattern of sin.
background: The prophets use “woe” to expose greed, violence, drunkenness, idolatry, injustice, and pride before God.
teachingHelp: Teach woe passages as merciful warnings as well as judgments; they reveal what God hates and call hearers to repentance.
